name: Ring of Regenerative Transformation
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 15th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of regeneration. As the ring’s regenerative powers are used, the wearer begins to transform physically and mentally into a troll.

For every 20 points regenerated, the wearer loses 1d2 points of Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma (to a minimum of 3 points) and gain 1d2 points of Strength and Constitution (to a maximum of 24). Additionally, each 20 points regenerated results in an alignment shift of one step towards chaotic evil. These transformations also manifest in physical changes in the appearance of the wearer: regenerated skin takes on a rougher appearance, regenerated appendages are troll-like in appearance, etc.

Once 100 points of damage have been regenerated, the transformation is complete and the wearer becomes a troll, complete with lack of regard for former companions whom she views as food for her enormous appetite. The wearer will immediately attack anyone in her area upon reaching this stage.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it which destroys the ring. Attribute changes revert back at the rate of 1 point per day, but any physical and/or alignment transformation the wearer has suffered remain and can only be cured with a miracle or wish.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of regeneration

Identification DC 40
False Identification DC 30
